appDescription: A family trip app for planning packing lists and manually confirming preparation, vehicle loading and recovery.

function.name: GET_PACKING_RECOMMENDATIONS
function.description: Show packing candidates calculated from the trip activity, duration and party composition for user review without changing the current packing list.

nights.description: The number of overnight stays, an integer from zero to fourteen.

adults.description: The number of adults, an integer from one to twelve.

children.description: The number of children excluding infants, an integer from zero to twelve.

infants.description: The number of infants, an integer from zero to six. The total party size must not exceed twenty.
